functions.tag: {title: "Mission Log", author: "Sergeant Fuse", pages: ["{\"text\": \"MISSION LOG\\nForward Operating Base Gigabyte\\n\\nPurpose: to guard a vault. The vault contains things. We were told not to ask what, and then told what, and then told to forget it.\"}", "{\"text\": \"DAY 1: Fence built. Turrets installed. Generator installed outside the fence, because the colonel said \\\"redundancy\\\" and then walked off.\\n\\nDAY 9: Nobody has attacked. We have started attacking the pigeons.\"}", "{\"text\": \"DAY 40: The turrets run off the shed outside the south wall. If somebody cuts the line the turrets and the vault door stop, which is the single design flaw I am not allowed to write on the whiteboard.\"}", "{\"text\": \"NOTE TO SELF: the vault door is held shut by a live cable behind it. Cut the cable and it opens. Hit it with an EMP and it opens. Ask it nicely and it will not.\\n\\nFile this under \\\"features\\\".\"}", "{\"text\": \"FINAL ENTRY: Command has gone quiet. The Security Robots have started humming. If you are reading this, please close the gate on your way out. It is a very expensive gate.\"}"]}
